```{r}
library(readr)
library(stargazer)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

anes_2020 <- read_csv("final project posc 230/anes_timeseries_2020_csv_20220210.csv",
                      na = c("", ". . ."), show_col_types = FALSE)

#clean 2020 data


#vax var
anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20 <- anes_2020$V202383x
anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20[anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20 < 0] <- NA
#table(anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20)
anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20 <- factor(anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20,
                                    levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6,7),
                                    labels = c("Health benefits much greater than risks","Health benefits moderately greater than risks","Health benefits slightly greater than risks", "No difference", "Risks slightly greather than health benefits", "Risks moderately greater than health benefits", "Risks much greater than health benefits"))

 

anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20_simple <- anes_2020$V202381
anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20_simple[anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20_simple < 0] <- NA
#table(anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20_simple)
anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20_simple <- factor(anes_2020$vax_hesitant_20_simple,
                                    levels = c(1,2,3),
                                    labels = c("Health benefits greater than risks", "No difference", "Risks greater than health benefits"))

## race var
anes_2020$race_20 <- anes_2020$V201549x - 1
anes_2020$race_20[anes_2020$race_20 < 0] <- NA
anes_2020$race_20 <- factor(anes_2020$race_20,
                            levels = c(1,2,3,4,5,6),
                            labels = c("White non-Hispanic","Black non-Hispanic", "Hispanic","Asian or Native Hawaiian/other Pacific Islander, non-Hispanic alone","Native American/Alaska Native or other race, non-Hispanic alone", "Multiple races, non-Hispanic"))

#table(anes_2020$race_20)
## binary race var

anes_2020$nonwhite_20 <- anes_2020$V201549x
anes_2020$nonwhite_20[anes_2020$nonwhite_20 < 0] <- NA
anes_2020$nonwhite_20[anes_2020$nonwhite_20 > 1] <- 2

anes_2020$nonwhite_20 <- factor(anes_2020$nonwhite_20,
                                levels = c(1,2),
                                labels = c("White non-Hispanic","Non-White"))



#black var
anes_2020$black <- anes_2020$V201549x
anes_2020$black[anes_2020$black < 0] <- NA
anes_2020$black[anes_2020$black == 2] <- 1
anes_2020$black[anes_2020$black != 2] <- 0

#asian var
anes_2020$asian <- anes_2020$V201549x
anes_2020$asian[anes_2020$asian < 0] <- NA
anes_2020$asian[anes_2020$asian != 4] <- 0
anes_2020$asian[anes_2020$asian == 4] <- 1


## gender var

anes_2020$female_20 <- anes_2020$V201600 - 1


anes_2020$female_20[anes_2020$female_20 < 0] <- NA


anes_2020$female_20 <- factor(anes_2020$female_20,
                              levels = c(1,2),
                              labels = c("Male","Female"))



##income var
anes_2020$income_20 <- anes_2020$V201617x - 1
anes_2020$income_20[anes_2020$income_20 < 0] <- NA

anes_2020$income_20 <- factor(anes_2020$income_20,
                              levels = seq(1,22, by = 1),
                              labels = c("Under $9,999", "$10,000-14,999", "$15,000-19,999", "$20,000-24,999", "$25,000-29,999", "$30,000-34,999", "$35,000-39,999", "$40,000-44,999", "$45,000-49,999", "$50,000-59,999", "$60,000-64,999", "$65,000-69,999", "$70,000-74,999", "$75,000-79,999", "$80,000-89,999", "$90,000-99,999", "$100,000-109,999", "$110,000-124,999", "$125,000-149,999", "$150,000-174,999", "$175,000-249,999", "$250,000 or more"))



## education var
anes_2020$edu_20 <- anes_2020$V201511x - 1
anes_2020$edu_20[anes_2020$edu_20 < 0] <- NA

anes_2020$edu_20 <- factor(anes_2020$edu_20,
                           levels = seq(1,5, by = 1),
                           labels = c("Less than high school credential", "High school credential", "Some post-high school, no bachelor’s degree", "Bachelor’s degree", "Graduate degree"))



## conspiracy var
anes_2020$conspiracy_20 <- anes_2020$V202312 - 1
anes_2020$conspiracy_20[anes_2020$conspiracy_20 < 0] <- NA

##party id
anes_2020$republican <- anes_2020$V201231x - 1
anes_2020$republican[anes_2020$republican < 0] <- NA
anes_2020$republican <- factor(anes_2020$republican,
                               levels = seq(1,7, by = 1),
                               labels = c("Strong Democrat", "Not Very Strong Democrat", "Independent-Democrat", "Independent", "Independent-Republican", "Not Very Strong Republican", "Strong Republican"))




##fox:
fox_news_programs <- c(anes_2020$V201630b,anes_2020$V201630c,anes_2020$V201630f,anes_2020$V201630g,anes_2020$V201630h,anes_2020$V201630k,anes_2020$V201631k)


anes_2020 <- anes_2020 |>
  mutate(fox = case_when(
    (V201630b < 0 | V201630c < 0 | V201630f < 0 | V201630g < 0 | V201630h < 0 | V201630k < 0 | V201631k < 0) ~ NA,
    (V201630b == 0 & V201630c == 0 & V201630f == 0 & V201630g == 0 & V201630h == 0 & V201630k == 0 & V201631k == 0) ~ 0,
    TRUE ~ 1
  ))





anes_2020_clean <- anes_2020 |>
  filter(!is.na(vax_hesitant_20_simple),
         !is.na(nonwhite_20),
         !is.na(race_20),
         !is.na(black),
         !is.na(asian),
         !is.na(female_20),
         !is.na(income_20),
         !is.na(edu_20),
         !is.na(conspiracy_20),
         !is.na(republican),
         !is.na(fox)
         )

ggplot(anes_2020_clean, aes(x = vax_hesitant_20_simple, fill = nonwhite_20)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge")

```
